notes.title: TOTALLY AWESOME RELEASE!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27867122/30e66d9516b3de5876b681a9bdcbe518a3458571.png
We’re so proud to release Super Cat Herding: Totally Awesome Edition!

We really want to thank you all for supporting our over-the-top charity game during Early Access. Some of the major new additions to the game include:
Kitty dreamland tutorial
Two new highly destructible levels
Host of new abilities
Of course, super hero kittens need capes
Chock full of inside jokes and parodies
Finally face the villains who stole our catnip!
Let the mayhem begin!  It's for a good cause after all!
